subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should core expose a current-session-only deferred `resetSession(reason?)` API to successful `after_compaction` hooks, and should the separate default failed-tool abort policy ship in the same change?
rationale: This adds a new plugin lifecycle capability and a new default run-termination rule; source correctness alone cannot decide their permanent public scope or whether they should be coupled.

options.title: Approve narrow reset API
options.body: Approve the scoped after-compaction API, add the bundled Codex owner, keep reset reconciliation, and move the generic failed-tool guard to a separate PR.

options.title: Approve the combined policy
options.body: Keep the reset API and failed-tool guard together only with explicit ownership approval and exact-head proof for both reset continuity and intentional run aborts.

options.title: Pause the API direction
options.body: Close or substantially narrow the PR if maintainers do not want compaction hooks to control session rotation from core.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow reset API
recommendation.body: Approve the scoped after-compaction API, add the bundled Codex owner, keep reset reconciliation, and move the generic failed-tool guard to a separate PR.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history most strongly connects this person to current Codex harness selection, native compaction, and gateway session-reset lifecycle behavior.
